kabuk.girisMetin: No password needed: log in within seconds using a code sent to your email.

kisisel.paylasimMetin: Only the hotel you book with can see it, and only your name and contact details.
kisisel.dogumMetin: Hotels ask for each guest's date of birth; if yours is saved here, we'll fill it in for you at checkout.
kisisel.adSoyadHata: Enter your first and last name
kisisel.kimlikNotu: Make sure it matches the name on your ID; the hotel will ask to see it at check-in.
kisisel.telefonYok: Not added — we recommend adding one in case the hotel needs to reach you
kisisel.uyrukNotu: The nationality on your passport or ID. Some hotels set prices based on nationality.

misafirler.aciklama: People you often travel with. Add them at checkout with a single tap.
misafirler.adSoyadHata: Enter their first and last name
misafirler.dogumHata: Enter the date of birth as DD.MM.YYYY

guvenlik.yontemEposta: Email code, no password. Each time you log in, we send a code to {eposta}.
guvenlik.oturumMetin: On a shared computer? Log out when you're done.
guvenlik.silMetin: Your personal info and saved guests will be deleted. If you have an upcoming booking, we'll sort it out together first.
guvenlik.silKonu: I'd like to delete my account
guvenlik.silGovde:
Hello,

I'd like to delete the LookBeds account registered to {eposta}.
guvenlik.sifreYokMetin: Instead of a password, we email you a one-time code each time you log in. It's valid for 10 minutes and works only once.
guvenlik.supheliMetin: If you get a code you didn't ask for, don't share it with anyone. As long as your email is secure, so is your account. Having trouble? Call {telefon}.

favoriler.bosMetin: Tap the heart on hotels you like while you search; we'll keep them all here.

favoriler.girisli: Hotels you heart are saved to your account
